history_summary: Retain all eleven native genus alternatives for the KZ Arthrobacter descriptor.
history_details: The selected genus-level Arthrobacter descriptor now records AMBIGUOUS with all eleven ordered native alternatives from the pinned ncbi_rank_g population. No alternative is selected for the study stock SZ-3. Preserve CW-D3T, the existing Klebsiella block, all source names, quotations, biological fields and old history. The retained abstract supports the two-stock community and bounded assay observations; no stock genome, causal transfer mechanism or new cultivation detail is established. Corrigendum PMID41456976, full Methods and supplements remain unreviewed under issue1541. Only one status/options set and one native event changed. The crosswalk release remains unestablished; its populations are not stock identity probabilities. This partial technical correction and its checks do not complete scientific review or corpus QC.
